title: Waiting for a spoken yes
description: The structured answer of a tool that will not act until Roy says yes aloud, such as calling a number not on the phone's own list. The voice reads say aloud; on a clear yes it calls confirm_with with the token, once.

say.description: The question, to be read aloud exactly.

token.description: Works once, for this question only.

confirm_with.description: The tool that takes the token, from the same plugin.

examples.say: Call 555 0100, who is not on your list?
